tells.1: Accumulated stock warmth: 'kept us on our toes', 'catch your breath', and 'glad to have you along' make the welcome feel padded.
tells.2: Consecutive reassurance formulas—'you're not alone' and 'Most of us are in the same boat'—repeat the point and introduce an unsupported claim.
tells.4: The closing 'Wherever you are with your winter preparations' feels mechanically attached to a request about the past season.

reason: Version 3 has the strongest editorial structure: an opening welcome, useful information, and a direct invitation to reply. It preserves warmth without repetitive reassurance or unnecessary framing; these are stylistic judgments, not proof of authorship.
